spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (कुरति)
To sound.

m. (-रः)
Boiled rice.

f. (-का)
The olibanum tree.

m. (-रः)
The Indian crane.
E.
कुर to sound, क aff., a sound, and कर what makes; also कुरङ्कुर.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A deer, an antelope.
E.
कुर to sound, अङ्गच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
A deer.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-ना)
A handsome woman.
E.
कुरङ्ग, and नयना the eye, fawn-eyed.

m. (-मः)
A deer, an antelope.

m. (-ल्लः)
A crab.

m. (-टः)
A currier, a leather-seller, a shoe-maker.
E.
कु bad, रट to speak, अच् affix; being described as a man of low occupation.

m. (-कः)
1 Yellow amaranth.
2 Yellow barleria: see कुरुण्टक.

m. (-ण्डः)
Enlargement of the testicles or rather of the scrotum, including inguinal hernia, hydrocele, &c.
E.
कु bad, ill, रम to play, and ड aff.

m. (-कः)
Yellow amaranth: see करुण्टक.

f. (-रः-रा)
An osprey; also another species of eagle.
f. (-री)
A sheep, an ewe.
2 A female osprey.

m. (-णः)
A flight of ospreys.
E.
कुररी, and गण a troop.

m. (-लः)
A curl, a lock of hair.
2 An osprey, see कुरुल.

m. (-लः)
A light bay horse, with black legs.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Having a bad voice.
m. (-वः)
1 A bad or harsh sound.
2 Red or yellow amaranth: see कुरवक.
E.
कु bad or ill, and रव what sounds.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Having a bad voice, making a disagreeable sound.
m. (-कः)
1 A purple sort of Jhinti or

Barleria.
2

A crimson species of amaranth.
E.
कु bad, रव to sound, क्वुन् aff.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Bad-juiced, of bad essence.
m. (-सः)
Spirituous or vinous liquor.
f. (-सा)
A wild creeping plant, a species of hieracium: see गोजिह्वा.
E.
कु bad, and रस juice.

f. (-री)
A kind of grass.

n. (-रं)
Copulation.
E.
कृ to do, ईरन् Uṇādi affix, उद् inserted.

m. (-रुः)
1 Kuru or Uttara Kuru, the most northerly of the four Mahā Dvīpas, or principal divisions of the known world; by other systems it is considered as one of nine divisions or Varṣas of the same; in both cases it is the country beyond the northern-most range of mountains, extending to the frozen ocean.
2 A proper name, son of AGNĪDHRA, and grandson of

PRIYAVRATA.
3

A proper name, a prince of the lunar race, son of SAṂVARAṆA by TAPATĪ; sovereign of the north-west of India or the country about Dehli, and ancestor of both PĀṆḌU and DHṚTARĀṢṬRA; the patronymic however derived from his name is most usually applied to the sons of the latter.
4 A holy place: see कुरुक्षेत्र.
5 Boiled rice.
6 Pricklynightshade: see कण्टकारिका.
E.
कृ to make, कु affix, and ऋ becomes उ.

n. (-कः)
Horseradish, (Raphanus sativus.)

n. (-त्रं)
The country near Dehli, the scene of the great battle between the Kurus and Pāṇḍus.
E.
कुरु the Kuru race, and क्षेत्र a field.

m. (-गः)
A solar day, in the course of which three lunar days, three asterisms and three Yogas occur.
E.
कुरुक्षेत्र, and योम conjunction.

m. (-ण्टः)
1 Yellow amaranth.
2 Yellow Barleria.
f. (-ण्टी)
1 A doll, a puppet.
2 The wife of a Brahman or teacher.
E.
कु bad, रुटि to shine, affix अण्.

m. (-कः)
1 Yellow or white amaranth.
2 A yellow species of Barleria, (B. prionitis.)
E.
कु bad, रुटि to shine, &c. ण्वुल् affix; also कुरण्टक.

n. (-म्बं)
A large species of orange.
f. (-म्बा)
Trumpet flower.

m. (-ट्)
A name of DURYODHANA.
E.
कुरु the Kuru race, राज to shine, and क्विप् affix; the Kuru chief.

f. (-री)
A kind of bird with a warbling note.

m. (-लः)
A curl or lock of hair, especially on the forehead.

m. (-कः)
1 The crimson amaranth.
2 A purple species of

Barleria.
3

Also a yellow kind.
E.
कु a little, रु to sound, क्वुन् affix, and उवङ् substituted for उ.

mn. (-न्दः-न्दं)
1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
2 A kind of barley: see कल्माष.
3 A ruby: see कुरुविल्ल.
4 Black salt.
E.
कुरु Kurudeśa, विन्द to gain, and शः affix; found in that country.

m. (-कः)
A kind of Dolichos biflorus, a wild variety.

m. (-ल्लः)
A ruby; also कुरुविल्व, and कुरुविन्द.

m. (-ल्वः)
A ruby; also कुरुविन्द.

m. (-स्तः)
A Pala of gold, a weight of gold equal to about 700 Troy grains.
E.
कुरु the country, and विस्त, abundant; abounding in Kurudeśa.

mfn. (-पः-पी-पं)
Ugly, ill made, deformed.
n. (-षं)
Ugliness.
E.
कु, and रूप form.

f. (-ता)
Ugliness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also कुरूपत्वं.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
Ugly, ill made, frightful, deformed.
E.
कुरूप, and इनि aff.

n. (-प्यं)
Tin.
E.
कु base, रूप्य silver.

mf. (-रः-री)
A dog or bitch.
E.
कुर् instead of कु bad, prefixed to कु to sound, and रक् affix: see कुक्कुर.

r. 1st cl. (कूर्दते or कुर्दते)
To play; also कूर्द.

r. 1st cl. (कूर्दते)
To play: see कुर्द.

n. (-नं)
Play, playing, sport: see कूर्दन.

n. (-नं)
Playing, sport, pastime.
f. (-नी)
A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA, held on the day of full moon, in the month Chaitra.
E.
कूर्द to play, ल्युट् affix, fem. ङीप्.

m. (-रः)
1 The knee.
2 The elbow; also कूर्पर.

mf. (-रः-रा)
1 The elbow.
2 The knee.
E.
कुर to sound, with क्विप् affix कुर, पर from पृ to nourish, the first vowel is made long; sometimes also कुर्पर.

m. (-सः)
A sort of bodice or jacket: see कूर्पास; also with कन् added कुर्पासक.

m. (-सः)
A cuirass or quilted jacket worn as armour: see कूर्प्पासक.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Doing, making.
E.
कृ to make, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-र्व्वन्-र्व्वन्ती-र्व्वत)
1 Doing, acting, an agent.
2 A servant.
E.
कृ to do, शतृ aff.

n. (-पं)
Cause according to the Cārvākas.
E.
कुर्व्वत्, and रुप nature.

mn. (-र्च्चः-र्च्चं)
1 The upper part of the nose, the part between the eye-brows.
2 The beard.
3 Deceit, fraud, circumvention.
4 Hard, solid.
5 The tip of the thumb and middle finger brought in contact, as to pinch, &c.
6 A handful of Kusa grass or peacock's feathers.
7 A bunch, a bundle, as of grass, &c.
8 A brush of the same.
9 The head.
10 False praise, unmerited commendation, either of one's self or another person, boasting, flattery.
11

Hypocrisy.
12

The mystic syllable Hum.
E.
कूर to sound, चङ् affix, or कृ to do, उर्च्च affix or कूर्च्च Sautra root, to praise, affix घञ्.

n. (-कं)
A brush for cleaning the teeth, &c.
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-रः)
The heel.

m. (-र्षः)
A drug, commonly Jivaka, one of the eight principal medicaments.
E.
कूर्च्च the beard, &c. and शीर्ष the head; being bearded: or from कूर्च्च praise, and शिर्ष chief; commendable amongst medicines; also with कन् added कूर्च्चशीर्षक.

m. (-रः)
The cocoa nut tree.
E.
कूर्च्च a bunch, and शेखर summit.

f. (-का)
1 Inspissated milk.
2 A key.
3 A bud, a blossom.
4 A painting brush or pencil.
5 A needle.
E.
कूर्च्च to praise, &c. वुन् affix, and the fem. form.

n. (-र्प्पं)
The space between the eye-brows.
E.
कॄ to scatter, &c. deriv. irr.: see कूर्च्च.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A bodice, a jacket with short sleeves worn next the body, by women especially.
E.
कूर्पर the elbow, आस to abide, घञ् affix, and र dropped, कूर्प्पास, see the preceding; again, कन् pleonastic affix added.

mf. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मी)
1 A tortoise, a turtle.
2 The descent of VIṢṆU as a tortoise to support the mountain Mandāra at the churning of the ocean.
3 A peculiar gesticulation with the fingers.
E.
कु implying reverse, ऊर्म्मी speed, अच् aff.

n. (-क्रं)
An astrological diagram.
E.
कूर्म्म, and चक्र circle.

n. (-ष्ठः)
1 Globe amaranth, (Gomphrena globosa.)
2 The back or shell of a tortoise.
E.
कूर्म्म a tortoise, and पृष्ठ the back.

n. (-कं)
The cover of a dish, a lid.
E.
कन् added to the preceding, implying resemblance.

m. (-जः)
The king of turtles, the tortoise supposed to uphold the world.
E.
कूर्म्म tortoise, and राज a king, from राजन् with टच् aff.
